name: MX Bikes
start: mkdir -p "results" ; mkdir -p "replays" ; [ -f "whitelist.txt" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "whitelist.txt")"; printf %s "" > "whitelist.txt"; } ; [ -f "blacklist.txt" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "blacklist.txt")"; printf %s "" > "blacklist.txt"; } ; SteamAppId="655500" wine "./mxbikes.exe" -dedicated {{port}} -set params dedicated.ini

config.title: dedicated.ini
config.default:
[connection]
name = AMP Powered MX Bikes Server
maxclient = 20
password = 
admin_password = 
bandwidth = 2
max_ping = 0
whitelist = whitelist.txt
blacklist = blacklist.txt
polls_disable = 0
location = 
MOTD = Welcome to my server!
chat_disable = 0

[export]

directory = results
units = 0
prefix =

contacts = 0

prefix =

category =

notes: Aus den AMP-Vorlagen von CubeCoders erzeugt (MIT), noch nicht im Selbsttest geprüft. Läuft über Wine. Einige Ports stehen nur in der Spielkonfiguration: Standard-Ports, nur ein Server pro Rechner. Braucht ein angemeldetes Steam-Konto (Einstellungen → Steam-Konto).
